dogecoin.text: If someone says #crypto #bitcoin #dogecoin or the like, you reply:
Rescue 2: #ElonMusk as “financial expert” unable to explain #Dogecoin given multiple chances.
Okay, the filmed spoof on the PA accents of #MareOfEasttown was pretty great, nice recovery after that horrid Icelandic TV thing.  And #Dogecoin no longer plunging. #SNL #ElonMusk
#Dogecoin dropping sharply, like 20 percent since #SNL started.  Told ya, this world is stupid weird.  It could all be back in minutes.

Now the nutty thing: #Musk is a big proponent of #Dogecoin cryptocurrency, which its based on nothing and seems to exist only to delight younger folks and annoy older folks.  But the flipping thing is up 61% this week,  roughly 1000% this month (but down 8% today).  So:

No idea what the future of #crypto is but no one should put a dime of non-disposable income into that rathole right now. #Bitcoin down almost 50 percent in three months, #Dogecoin down more than 50 percent in 6 months. Don’t be stupid.
